articles.title: Tuxedo Launches InfinityBook Pro 15 Gen11 Lightweight Linux Ultrabook with Ryzen AI 9
articles.text:
Thursday, November 19th 2026
Tuxedo Launches InfinityBook Pro 15 Gen11 Lightweight Linux Ultrabook with Ryzen AI 9
The TUXEDO InfinityBook Pro 15 - Gen11 combines a pleasantly large, bright 15.3-inch screen with plenty of speed for software developers and media content creators, thanks to a 12-core AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 and up to 128 GB of RAM. At the same time, it is built for mobility: an ultra-thin and very light all-aluminium body, a maximum-sized 99 Wh battery and flexible USB-C charging.
Very Light and Ultra-Slim All-aluminium Chassis
Despite weighing just 1.75 kg and measuring under 20 mm thick (chassis plus slim-bezel display lid), the InfinityBook Pro 15 features a sturdy all-metal case. It not only feels great to the touch but also reliably protects the hardware inside during transport.On a compact footprint of just 342 × 238 mm, the 15.3-inch Linux notebook fits a full keyboard with a four-column number pad and full-size arrow keys in an offset position for better ergonomics, as well as a glass precision touchpad for convenient navigation on the go.
Under the hood, two ultra-low-profile fans and heatpipes keep the InfinityBook Pro 15 quiet under light load and deliver up to 90 W of sustained CPU performance at full fan speed.Power-Saving Yet Powerful: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470
The InfinityBook Pro 15 is powered by the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470, designed to strike a great balance between performance and efficiency. With 12 cores (24 threads) built on an energy-efficient 4 nm process, it is well suited for demanding workloads like video editing, fast code compilation and running AI language models (LLMs) locally.
CPU performance can be adjusted with three profiles: for everyday tasks, "Balanced" mode limits the CPU to 35 W for solid performance with quiet fans. For demanding workloads, "Enthusiast" mode raises the limit to 54 W, while "Overboost" unlocks the full 90 W.
Integrated Graphics for Light Gaming
All graphics rendering and display output is handled by the integrated AMD Radeon 890M. With 16 graphics cores, the power-saving GPU easily drives up to three external displays and offers enough performance for graphically less demanding PC games in 1080p.
For substantially faster graphics for 3D animation and gaming at the display's native 1600p resolution, the almost identically compact InfinityBook Max 15 rounds out the lineup.Bright High-Res 15.3-Inch Screen and Optional ANSI Keyboard
The 15.3-inch display closes the gap between the very compact but somewhat small 14-inch format and the larger 16-inch format.
With 2560 × 1600 pixels in the productivity-friendly 16:10 aspect ratio and 100 % sRGB coverage, the 330 × 207 mm screen is well suited for creative work and multimedia, while a brightness of 500 nits ensures good legibility in bright rooms and outdoors.The display lid tilts back up to 180° for maximum flexibility with all kinds of laptop stands, and a privacy shutter prevents unauthorized access to the 1080p webcam.
Speaking of flexibility: besides our individual keyboard laser engraving service offered across all products, the InfinityBook Pro 15 is available in two physical keyboard layouts:
- in matte black with an ISO keyboard
- in silver-grey with an ANSI keyboard (available in early 2027)
99 Wh Battery, USB-C Charging and up to 128 GB RAM
Beyond its light and thin form factor, the InfinityBook Pro 15 meets the highest mobility requirements with a 99 Wh battery - the maximum permitted on board an aircraft - and flexible charging via USB-C Power Delivery (60 to 150 W).
Up to three external monitors can be connected via USB4, USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 and HDMI. For data, there are three USB Type-A ports, a full-size card reader and a LAN port.
RAM and SSD each sit in two easily accessible slots and can be upgraded to up to 128 GB of DDR5-5600 RAM and 8 TB of PCIe 4.0 SSD storage.
Available for Pre-Order Now, Shipping Starts Early December
Like all TUXEDO notebooks, the InfinityBook Pro 15 ships ready to use with full Linux support, including in-house-developed apps for enhanced functionality and Linux-trained customer service. Officially supported operating systems include our in-house curated TUXEDO OS, Ubuntu (both with optional full disk encryption) and Windows 11.
The base configuration with the Ryzen AI 9 HX 470, 2x 8 GB DDR5-5600 RAM, a 500 GB PCIe 4.0 SSD and TUXEDO OS starts at around 1500 EUR (excl. VAT / import duties).
Source:

articles.title: Google leva histórico de IA à página inicial • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Google leva histórico de IA à página inicial
Barra lateral reúne conversas recentes, permite retomar pesquisas e iniciar novos tópicos; recurso começa a chegar à versão para computadores.
Google adiciona uma barra lateral à página inicial para acessar conversas recentes com inteligência artificial.
Recurso permite retomar pesquisas, procurar conversas anteriores e iniciar novos tópicos com o Modo IA.
Novidade está sendo liberada globalmente e reforça a integração da IA ao buscador.
O Google começou a liberar uma barra lateral no buscador para facilitar o acesso a interações anteriores com a inteligência artificial. O recurso reúne pesquisas recentes feitas no Modo IA e permite continuar conversas sem precisar começar uma nova consulta.
A novidade foi anunciada nesta quinta-feira (19) pelo vice-presidente da pesquisa, Robby Stein. Segundo o executivo, a ferramenta está sendo disponibilizada globalmente na versão para computadores e promete facilitar a continuidade das pesquisas.
Ao abrir o painel, o usuário encontra uma lista de conversas recentes feitas com o Modo IA. A interface também oferece atalhos para iniciar uma nova interação, procurar tópicos anteriores e conectar um Gemini Notebook. A barra pode ser recolhida para liberar espaço e voltar à apresentação tradicional do buscador.
O recurso não reúne todo o histórico de pesquisas do Google. Ele funciona como um atalho para conversas feitas no Modo IA, ferramenta que permite elaborar perguntas mais complexas. Assim, quem começou uma pesquisa sobre determinado assunto pode voltar a ela depois, sem precisar repetir as perguntas anteriores.
A mudança também aproxima a página inicial de uma experiência de chatbot. Em vez de servir apenas como ponto de partida para pesquisas na web, o buscador passa a oferecer um espaço para organizar e continuar conversas.
A novidade faz parte de uma série de mudanças na interface do buscador. Em agosto, o Tecnoblog noticiou testes com novos botões na página inicial, que ofereciam atalhos para gerar imagens, consultar documentos e fazer brainstorming com auxílio de IA. Mais recentemente, a empresa anunciou as conversas temporárias, que permitem fazer perguntas sem salvar a interação no histórico.
Com a nova barra lateral, a empresa aposta em uma experiência na qual o usuário pode iniciar uma pesquisa, consultar informações e voltar ao assunto mais tarde. A distribuição global do recurso começou no desktop, mas o Google ainda não detalhou quando a novidade chegará a todos os usuários.

articles.title: Descarga gratis el mapa de Leonida de GTA 6: por qué deberías tenerlo
articles.text:
GTA 6 ya está disponible en PS5 y Xbox Series X|S y, junto al lanzamiento, Rockstar Games cumplió su promesa: el mapa de Leonida y el arte de portada del juego ya se pueden descargar gratis desde la web oficial, una alternativa pensada para compensar la ausencia del tradicional mapa físico que solía incluirse en las cajas de la saga.
La noticia llega en medio de un lanzamiento que combina éxito de crítica y ventas con una polémica puntual sobre el formato físico del título. La edición en caja de GTA 6 no trae disco ni mapa impreso, solo un código de descarga y un póster a doble cara.
Ante los reclamos de parte de la comunidad, la desarrolladora decidió liberar estos materiales de forma digital para todos los jugadores.
Cómo descargar el mapa de Leonida y el póster de GTA 6
El proceso es sencillo y no requiere ningún registro adicional. Hay que ingresar a la página oficial de GTA VI, en www.rockstargames.com/VI, y desde el menú de tres rayas ubicado en la esquina superior derecha seleccionar la pestaña de Multimedia o Arte y fondos de pantalla.
Allí aparecen cuatro elementos disponibles para descarga: el mapa de Leonida y el póster de arte de portada, cada uno en dos versiones, una estándar y otra pensada específicamente para impresión.
Ambos archivos comparten las mismas dimensiones: 19,25 de ancho por 26,33 pulgadas de alto, equivalentes a 48,9 de ancho por 66,9 centímetros de alto. Cabe señalar que la calidad es alta y a todo color, aunque el resultado final dependerá de la impresora o el formato que elija cada usuario para imprimirlo.
Por qué conviene tener el mapa de Leonida a mano durante el juego
Contar con este recurso fuera de la pantalla principal cambia la forma de jugar durante las primeras horas, sobre todo para quienes buscan explorar sin depender todo el tiempo del menú interno.
Se trata, además, del primer diseño geográfico oficial de Leonida. Durante años, la comunidad solo contó con mapas elaborados por fans a partir de filtraciones, pero ahora existe un plano real que detalla con precisión las infraestructuras viales de Vice City, los pantanos de Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn y la disposición de los Cayos de Leonida.
Guardar una copia digital en una tablet, o imprimir el mapa, permite planificar rutas y localizar vías fluviales sin pausar la partida para abrir el menú, lo que favorece una experiencia más inmersiva.
El archivo fue exportado por los propios desarrolladores con fines de impresión, por lo que puede llevarse a un centro de copiado para obtener un póster físico con calidad profesional, similar al que acompañaba a las ediciones clásicas de la saga.
Por último, el mapa permite identificar con rapidez las transiciones entre zonas urbanas densas y áreas salvajes, como el Parque Nacional Monte Kalaga o Ambrosia, lo que ayuda a anticipar si una misión requerirá un vehículo todoterreno, una lancha o un auto deportivo.
El futuro de la edición física de GTA 6
Pese a la disponibilidad gratuita de estos materiales, persiste la expectativa por una edición física completa, con disco incluido. Esa posibilidad no está descartada del todo, y podría concretarse si Rockstar decide llevar GTA VI a PC o a Nintendo Switch 2 en el futuro.
Por el momento, el juego está disponible en PS5 y Xbox Series X|S, tanto en formato físico con código en caja como en formato digital, mientras que el mapa de Leonida y el póster de arte pueden descargarse de manera gratuita desde la web oficial de Rockstar Games.

articles.title: Panne massive : impôts, Assurance maladie… plusieurs sites officiels inaccessibles ce jeudi
articles.text:
Plusieurs services publics ont mis en maintenance tout ou partie de leurs sites ce jeudi après-midi, dont ceux des impôts, de l’Assurance maladie et du ministère de la Justice. Selon l’ANSSI, ces coupures pourraient être liées à l’installation urgente de correctifs contre des failles critiques, et l’agence n’a connaissance d’aucune attaque en cours.
Rideau ! Sur impots.gouv.fr, vous pouvez toujours vous connecter à votre espace personnel, mais impossible de télécharger un formulaire ou de consulter les actualités, a constaté Le Parisien. « Nos équipes sont pleinement mobilisées pour rétablir l’accès à l’ensemble des fonctionnalités du site dans les meilleurs délais », écrit la DGFiP sur sa page d’accueil. Sur ameli.fr, l’Assurance maladie prévient par un bandeau que « certaines fonctionnalités ne sont pas disponibles », mais vous pouvez encore ouvrir votre compte. Et ce jeudi après-midi, l’équipe de PHP, le langage informatique qui fait tourner une grande partie des sites web, a publié une nouvelle série de correctifs critiques.
Protégez votre entreprise gratuitement pendant 30 jours
Découvrez Bitdefender Ultimate Small Business Security et protégez votre activité contre les cybermenaces. Aucune coordonnée bancaire requise.
L’ANSSI a ordonné aux ministères d’installer les correctifs en urgence
Le 21 octobre, à la demande de l’ANSSI, le ministère de l’Intérieur avait mis en maintenance l’ensemble de ses sites exposés à deux failles critiques de PHP, et de nombreux sites publics étaient encore hors service le lendemain. « L’ANSSI n’a pas connaissance d’attaque en cours, mais des correctifs pour plusieurs vulnérabilités critiques (...) ont été diffusés, et leur application urgente peut entraîner l’arrêt temporaire pour maintenance de nombreux sites », a répondu l’agence chargée de la cybersécurité de l’État au Parisien.
L’ANSSI a en outre « adressé une injonction aux ministères » pour qu’ils appliquent ces correctifs. Les ministères ont donc reçu l’ordre de mettre leurs serveurs à jour sans attendre, quitte à couper leurs sites le temps de l’opération.
PHP a corrigé une nouvelle faille critique ce jeudi
L’équipe de sécurité de PHP avait annoncé mercredi des mises à jour pour toutes les versions encore maintenues du langage, de PHP 8.2 à PHP 8.5, avec le niveau de gravité le plus élevé. Elle a publié ce jeudi après-midi les versions 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28 et 8.5.13, avec une vingtaine de failles corrigées dans chacune, d’après Next. Le Parisien ignore pour l’instant si ces correctifs ont provoqué les coupures, d’autant que les correctifs évoqués par l’ANSSI ont été diffusés mercredi, selon le quotidien, soit la veille de la publication de PHP.
Avec la faille CVE-2026-115560, la plus attendue de ce lot, un pirate peut exécuter du code à distance sur un serveur, en passant par la fonction de PHP qui suit la progression de l’envoi d’un fichier. L’équipe de PHP l’avait signalée dès le 23 octobre, mais selon elle, son exploitation demande une configuration inhabituelle du serveur. En attendant la mise à jour, les administrateurs peuvent bloquer cette attaque en désactivant le réglage session.upload_progress.enabled, selon le blogueur Korben.
En octobre, des pirates ont réussi à exploiter les failles PHP2Shell, et de nombreux serveurs attendent encore ces correctifs, rappelle Next. Le site d’information conseille de mettre PHP à jour au plus vite, car les pirates analysent aujourd’hui les correctifs avec des modèles d’IA pour concevoir très vite une attaque.

articles.title: Hackers steal over 1 million credit card details across 20 countries — attackers hit old Windows bug to infect over 700 point-of-sale terminals
articles.text:
Hackers steal over 1 million credit card details across 20 countries — attackers hit old Windows bug to infect over 700 point-of-sale terminals
Most victims are located in Brazil
- Researchers uncover a payment-card theft campaign that compromised 782 point-of-sale systems and exposed data from over one million cards
- Attackers used outdated Windows systems and malware to harvest card details, banking information, and transaction data
- Consumers across more than 20 countries face increased risks of fraud, account takeover, and targeted phishing attacks
Someone stole details of more than a million credit and debit cards, potentially allowing them to make fraudulent purchases or account takeovers. Consumers in more than 20 countries around the world are now at risk, according to the researchers who discovered the theft.
Security researchers from Cybernews discovered an exposed server containing complete infrastructure used in a hacking attack against point-of-sale (POS) terminals - devices merchants use in stores to process card payments.
That infrastructure included the source code of the malware used in attacks, various exploitation tools, as well as a carding panel named “VINY JUNIOR TRILHAS” which stored exfiltrated payment card data.
Card numbers and other details
The malware was used against POS terminals running different but outdated versions of Windows and Windows Server. It leveraged a bug tracked as CVE-2024-49138, a privilege elevation flaw in Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver that requires initial access before it can be abused. It was patched almost two years ago, which means the victims used a severely outdated and vulnerable endpoint for years.
In total, 782 systems were compromised, most of which were in Brazil (677). Other notable mentions include the United States with 22 endpoints, and Russia with 8.
Using the malware, the attacker installed an infostealer on the endpoints, and pulled data as it was running through, including Primary Account Numbers (PANs), validity periods, Bank Identification Numbers (BINs), issuing countries, issuing banks, exfiltration dates, and card types and brands.
The attacker also stole information about the compromised POS terminals, including the operating system versions and geographic locations (both country and city). On the server, the Cybernews team also found the attackers primarily targeted Brazilian banks.

The researchers said this was not a one-off smash-and-grab, but rather a prolonged campaign in which the POS terminals were relaying daily transactions. The exposed server was finally locked down on August 31 2026, while Cybernews reported it to the country’s Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) on September 8.
“At least a million cardholders face potential financial fraud, including unauthorized purchases and account takeovers,” the researchers warned. “The risk depends on individual banks' fraud detection systems and cardholder protection policies.”
“Cardholders may experience financial damages depending on their issuing bank's fraud protection policies and how quickly fraudulent transactions are detected and reported.”
Leveraging stolen data
Personally identifiable information (PII) gets stolen every day. Credit and debit card data - not so much. The latter is, obviously, infinitely more disruptive, since the victims can end up with their bank accounts entirely drained, but most banks have different limits and fraud protection policies which make it somewhat difficult for attackers to actually spend people’s money. Most transactions can also be traced, meaning the attackers are risking unveiling their identities in the process.
But there are things they can use the cards for - to buy bulletproof hosting services where they can host malware and other hacking tools; to purchase ads on reputable ad networks and promote malware or even ransomware; or to buy redeemable gift cards that are practically untraceable. Losing hundreds of thousands of dollars is not entirely off the table, but there are better chances crooks would make relatively smaller purchases instead.
They can also just sell the data on the dark web and let someone else worry about spending the money.
Finally, they can use the information about the credit cards to launch convincing phishing attacks and escalate the compromise even further. For example, they could “warn” a victim that their credit card is being used and urge them to immediately block it by clicking on a link in the email. That could result in ransomware deployment, from which the attackers could extort millions of dollars that are much harder to trace.

articles.title: AMD Stock Dives 15% Over Shortseller Report Alleging Export Control Violations to China, Rebounds Later
articles.text:
Thursday, November 19th 2026
AMD Stock Dives 15% Over Shortseller Report Alleging Export Control Violations to China, Rebounds Later
The AMD stock briefly crashed 15% in 30 minutes after a report by market research firm Hunterbrook Media alleged that AMD "has its own China problem," alleging export control violations resembling those by NVIDIA, which cost CEO Jensen Huang his job. The firm disclosed that it holds a shorting position against the AMD stock. Unlike in NVIDIA's case which involved alleged smuggling of advanced AI GPUs to AI research and inferencing firms in China; AMD has a problem with improper exports of controlled server systems to IEIT Systems, a Chinese server builder placed on export controls by the U.S. Government, the report alleges.
It is very important to note here that the report itself says that these findings don't necessarily prove an export control violation—that restricted products were either directly or indirectly transferred from AMD to IEIT Systems—it only notes IEIT's server firmware implementing newer versions of AGESA microcode that it normally shouldn't have access to, given that it is no longer supposed to be doing business with AMD. AGESA isn't publicly available software, it is a software component that's encapsulated into system firmware by OEMs, and implementing it requires an OEM to be doing business with AMD and be subject to its terms of sale and other agreements. It's entirely possible that IEIT Systems obtained AGESA through illicit means, by sourcing it from bad actors within another OEM that's currently doing business with AMD, or IEIT's engineers "transplanted" it from finished-product firmware distributed by a lawful OEM.The Hunterbrook report alleges that blacklisted Chinese server assembler, IEIT Systems incorporated at least six newer versions of AMD startup firmware since March 2025, with nearly identical code appearing in products from three non-blacklisted affiliates (Aivres, Kaytus, and Maginfra). The report also flags AMD's broader China exposure, noting it generated $67 million in 2025 licensing income from two blacklisted ventures, billed 22.4% of its 2025 revenue to China and Hong Kong, and relies heavily on Chinese joint ventures for chip assembly, alongside financial strain from over $33 billion in guarantees and up to 320 million shares in AI-customer stock obligations.

articles.title: Nadella: sistemas essenciais têm falhas que não podem ser corrigidas • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Nadella: sistemas essenciais têm falhas que não podem ser corrigidas
Satya Nadella cita equipamentos de refrigeração, ar-condicionado e transporte conectados à internet; IA também acelera a descoberta de vulnerabilidades.
O CEO da Microsoft, Satya Nadella, alertou que parte da infraestrutura crítica dos Estados Unidos utiliza sistemas com falhas de segurança que não podem ser corrigidas por atualizações convencionais. Entre os exemplos citados estão sistemas de refrigeração, ar-condicionado e equipamentos utilizados no transporte.
A declaração foi feita nesta quarta-feira (18) durante um evento organizado pelo New York Times. Na entrevista, Nadella chamou atenção para os riscos de conectar equipamentos antigos à internet sem mecanismos para corrigir vulnerabilidades.
Entre os exemplos mencionados por Nadella estão os chillers, equipamentos utilizados para resfriar instalações como data centers, além de sistemas responsáveis pelo aquecimento, ventilação e ar-condicionado de edifícios.
O executivo também mencionou sistemas de transporte que utilizam firmware vulnerável. Na avaliação dele, a digitalização de equipamentos que antes funcionavam de maneira isolada ampliou a superfície de ataque disponível para criminosos, já que nem todos esses dispositivos foram projetados para receber atualizações frequentes. Em alguns casos, a tecnologia utilizada não oferece um caminho simples para corrigir vulnerabilidades.
Nadella não apresentou exemplos de ataques bem-sucedidos contra os equipamentos mencionados, mas defendeu a modernização dessas estruturas e a ampliação dos mecanismos de monitoramento e defesa.
Outro ponto levantado por Nadella envolve a velocidade com que vulnerabilidades podem ser descobertas e exploradas. Segundo ele, ferramentas de inteligência artificial já conseguem identificar problemas em programas com mais rapidez, enquanto a própria tecnologia facilita a execução de ataques sofisticados, reduzindo o tempo que empresas têm para analisar uma falha, testar uma atualização e distribuir a correção.
Nadella afirmou que correções precisam chegar rapidamente aos sistemas quando uma falha já está sendo explorada, mas reconheceu que esse processo aumenta o risco de complicações operacionais. O executivo também comentou a recente pane global do Outlook e de outros serviços da Microsoft. Ele atribuiu o incidente a um erro de software que acabou criando uma combinação de fatores desfavoráveis. A empresa já havia esclarecido que a interrupção não foi provocada por um ataque hacker.
A discussão ocorre em um momento de preocupação com o uso de IA em ataques cibernéticos. Recentemente, pesquisadores também utilizaram a tecnologia para encontrar uma vulnerabilidade crítica no Java, demonstrando como ferramentas automatizadas podem acelerar a identificação de problemas de segurança.

articles.title: Lawmakers form bipartisan caucus to create meaningful AI safety legislation - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Lawmakers form bipartisan caucus to create meaningful AI safety legislation
A bipartisan group of more than two dozen congressional lawmakers said today they’re forming a new AI Safety and Innovation Caucus to tackle the growing security risks posed by the advances in sophisticated artificial intelligence models.
The lawmakers cited the July hack of Hugging Face Inc.’s servers by a team of autonomous AI agents developed by OpenAI Group PBC, which broke out of an isolated sandbox environment, as an example of these risks. They also pointed to another incident involving the now-public Anthropic PBC, which also reported that its agents escaped their testing environments to access third-party systems.
These incidents have “underscored the need for Congress to better understand these risks and develop policy solutions,” said Representative George Whitesides (D-California), a co-chair of the caucus. “As AI capabilities accelerate, so do the potential consequences of catastrophic misuse, loss of control over advanced systems and threats to national security.”
Whitesides (pictured) is co-chairing the caucus alongside Representatives Nathanial Moran (R-TX) and Don Beyer (D-Virginia). In a post on X, they stressed the need for bipartisan collaboration to create the basic policy guardrails for AI safety, citing the growing concerns of the American public.
Does it feel like there's a new tech or AI crisis every day? Recent headlines are raising serious concerns about our digital safety and security.
Today, I'm joining @RepDonBeyer, @RepNateMoran, and over 20 of our colleagues to launch the bipartisan AI Safety and Innovation… pic.twitter.com/bhMyygy1J6
— Rep. George Whitesides (@Rep_Whitesides) November 19, 2026
The 26-member caucus includes seven Republicans, which is a surprising number given that the White House administration under President Donald Trump has strongly opposed any heavy-handed regulation of the AI industry. The goal of the caucus is to identify “targeted solutions” that ensure AI remains under control without derailing innovation and threatening America’s lead in the industry.
Whitesides said the lawmakers will focus on two things: proposing legislation to augment AI safety, and responding quickly to high-profile security incidents by gathering developers, independent experts and government officials to brief lawmakers and come up with solutions.
“We want to be a conduit through which effective, responsible legislation can be refined and brought to the floor of the House,” Whitesides told Politico in an interview. He said the group will work together to propose, provide feedback and endorse new AI legislation. He believes there’s an urgent need for this, because most other groups within the House are more focused on educating members or creating legislation within their own parties, he said.
Another thing the caucus intends to do is to pursue relationships with outside AI experts who can help lawmakers to navigate complex policy decisions. It also wants to help raise public awareness around AI and its safety issues, and ensure members outside of relevant committees have the tools they need to contribute to new legislation and debate.
In the recent midterm elections, Americans made it clear that AI is becoming a major issue for governance. Moreover, a recent survey revealed that 43% of Americans don’t trust either of the two major political parties to properly get a grip on AI safety, according to a one-pager that accompanied the press release.
“Artificial intelligence affects every American, and it should not be a partisan issue,” Moran said. “This caucus gives us a place to find the areas of consensus, set partisanship aside and put smart, targeted policies in place so we can innovate while we keep people safe. Congress needs to be prepared.”

articles.title: Ajustes para evitar que el Smart TV no espíe a ningún familiar y recopile sus datos
articles.text:
Los televisores inteligentes recopilan datos constantemente sobre lo que sus dueños miran, sin que la mayoría lo note. La tecnología detrás de esta vigilancia tiene nombre: Reconocimiento Automático de Contenido, conocido por sus siglas en inglés como ACR.
El ACR identifica prácticamente cualquier cosa que aparezca en pantalla: contenido de aplicaciones propias del televisor, canales de televisión abierta, consolas y dispositivos conectados por HDMI. Para lograrlo, genera una huella digital de lo que se reproduce y la compara con bases de datos hasta reconocer el programa o la escena exacta.
Qué es el ACR y por qué preocupa
Es una función integrada en el hardware de la mayoría de los televisores inteligentes que captura audio y capturas de pantalla cada pocos segundos para identificar el contenido visualizado. Esa información se envía al fabricante, que la usa para construir perfiles de consumo y vender publicidad dirigida.
Según la compañía de ciberseguridad Kaspersky, algunas funciones del televisor podrían ser aprovechadas por personas no autorizadas si el dispositivo no está correctamente protegido. Por su parte, Proton señala que esta recopilación suele quedar oculta entre los ajustes del equipo o viene activada de fábrica, lo que hace que muchos usuarios la acepten sin saberlo al configurar el televisor por primera vez.
Cómo desactivar el ACR y la publicidad personalizada
El primer paso para frenar el rastreo consiste en localizar la opción de ACR en el menú de configuración. Cada fabricante utiliza un nombre distinto para esta función, por lo que conviene buscar instrucciones específicas según la marca del televisor antes de desactivarla.
Desactivar el ACR no siempre garantiza que la recolección de datos desaparezca por completo, ya que la disponibilidad de este ajuste depende de cada fabricante.
El segundo ajuste recomendado es desactivar la publicidad personalizada, una opción que suele estar separada del ACR dentro del propio menú de privacidad. La organización Network Advertising Initiative, dedicada a promover una recolección de datos más responsable, mantiene un listado con los pasos para acceder y controlar el identificador publicitario en las principales plataformas de televisores inteligentes.
- Controlar micrófonos y asistentes de voz
Algunos fabricantes han enfrentado acusaciones de recolectar audio ambiental, incluso con el televisor en modo de espera. La justificación habitual es que el micrófono necesita permanecer activo para detectar la palabra que activa el asistente de voz.
Quien no utiliza con frecuencia estas funciones puede desactivar el asistente de voz y cualquier servicio de reconocimiento de voz desde los ajustes del televisor. Algunos modelos incorporan, además, un botón físico para silenciar el micrófono de forma permanente, una opción recomendable para quienes buscan eliminar por completo este canal de escucha.
- Desconectar el televisor o filtrar sus conexiones
La medida más eficaz para reducir el seguimiento, de acuerdo con Proton, es mantener el televisor desconectado de internet y reproducir el contenido desde un dispositivo externo controlado por el usuario, como un reproductor multimedia o un servidor doméstico conectado mediante HDMI.
Muchos televisores modernos incluyen un modo básico que se puede elegir durante la configuración inicial y que convierte el equipo en una pantalla convencional, sin conexión a internet ni recopilación de datos en segundo plano.
Para quienes necesiten mantener el televisor conectado a la red, existe la herramienta Pi-hole, capaz de bloquear la telemetría y las conexiones con dominios publicitarios sin afectar al resto de los servicios del dispositivo. Otra alternativa es recurrir a un reproductor de streaming externo, ya que aunque también recopila cierta información, no abarca todo lo conectado al televisor.
El caso de LG y las redes de proxies residenciales
LG anunció que suspenderá las aplicaciones de su plataforma webOS que conviertan los televisores de los usuarios en nodos de redes de proxies residenciales sin información clara ni consentimiento adecuado.
La decisión llegó después de que una investigación de KrebsOnSecurity detectara que más del 42% de las aplicaciones disponibles en la tienda de webOS incorporaban esta tecnología, capaz de redirigir el tráfico de internet de terceros a través de la conexión doméstica del usuario.
La compañía exigirá a los desarrolladores eliminar esta funcionalidad y retirará las aplicaciones que no cumplan con la medida. LG busca también endurecer el proceso de revisión de aplicaciones para evitar que sus televisores sean utilizados como parte de estas redes sin que sus propietarios lo sepan.

articles.title: La Commission européenne victime d'une cyberattaque
articles.text:
Les cyberattaques se multiplient, et visent de grandes institutions. Comme, cette fois, la Commission européenne !
La question des cyberattaques inquiète de plus en plus, et entraîne finalement une réponse - qui aura traîné - de la part des autorités. Le projet de loi Résilience va en effet permettre de muscler la cybersécurité chez de très nombreux organismes. Et ça ne sera pas de trop, au vu de ce qui se fait dorénavant comme attaques dans le monde cybernétique, avec notamment l'émergence de l'intelligence artificielle.
La Commission européenne victime d'une cyberattaque qui a duré 10 jours
La Commission européenne vient de confirmer officiellement une information de Politico selon laquelle elle a été la victime d'une cyberattaque. Et l'attaque est importante, même si elle a finalement été stoppée, si l'on en croit les sources anonymes du média.
« La Commission estime avoir maîtrisé l'essentiel de l'attaque, mais l'ampleur exacte des dégâts reste incertaine » a ainsi expliqué l'une d'elles. « Les systèmes pourraient être en train de se remettre en ligne. Les réponses prennent un peu plus de temps » a-t-il par ailleurs été ajouté. Au total, le problème a duré 10 jours.
Une cyberattaque qui a utilisé ARTEX, un outil de cybersécurité alimenté par l'IA
Cette cyberattaque a rendu impossible le fonctionnement de plateformes internes, et a potentiellement compromis de larges volumes de données personnelles. Le piratage nous renvoie par ailleurs à l'avertissement lancé par le FBI le 13 novembre dernier. L'agence fédérale avait en effet pointé du doigt la plateforme chinoise Artex, qui utilise les grands modèles IA pour automatiser l'ensemble d'une cyberattaque.
Et la cyberattaque qui a touché la Commission européenne a utilisé cet outil. Un outil qui, a la base, a été mis au point afin de d'identifier les vulnérabilités dans les systèmes IA des entreprises. « Certains acteurs font un usage abusif de ces outils et ont pris la Commission pour cible » a indiqué une source de Politico. Est-on au début d'une grande ère de piraterie ?
Source : Politico

articles.title: Industrial monitoring startup BrightAI closes $97M investment - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Industrial monitoring startup BrightAI closes $97M investment
BrightAI Inc., a startup that helps industrial companies detect malfunctioning equipment, has raised $97 million in funding.
Smith Point Capital led the Series A round. BrightAI said in its Wednesday announcement of the deal that a number of other venture capital firms contributed as well. They were joined by GE Vernova Inc., an energy equipment company that emerged from the 2024 split-up of General Electric Co.
Many industrial machinery malfunctions affect internal components that aren’t visible to an outside observer. As a result, issues often go unnoticed until they cause a major disruption. Palo Alto, California-based BrightAI develops hardware and software tools that help customers spot issues earlier.
The first component of the company’s product portfolio is a collection of sensors called State Stickers. They’re small, rectangular devices with a ruggedized case and a long battery life. Technicians can attach them to industrial equipment to monitor for issues that can’t be detected visually.
The motion of a machine’s internal components produces noise and vibrations that tend to follow a specific pattern. If an industrial fan’s blades rotate 30 times per minute, it might give off a whooshing sound every two seconds. BrightAI’s State Stickers can detect when a machine diverges from its usual operating pattern.
The sensors wirelessly transmit their measurements to a device called the Stateful AI Hub. It runs artificial intelligence models that analyze the data for signs of hardware failures. According to the company, its models become more accurate as the number of sensors deployed at a site grows.
BrightAI offers software that enables companies to augment the data from its sensors with drone footage. A utility, for example, could use a BrightAI-powered drone to detect erosion at the top of an electric pole. The company’s AI models automatically draw a square around damaged components to spare technicians the hassle of manually analyzing footage.
The company says that its software can also collect maintenance data in other ways. A BrightAI-powered drone can read the meters that are attached to assets such as data center coolant tanks to check their internal pressure. Furthermore, built-in support for infrared cameras enables the software to spot overheating equipment.
The third core component of BrightAI’s product portfolio is an AI wearable. The Stateful Wearable, as it’s called, provides technicians with troubleshooting advice in the field. It also checks whether they follow safety guidelines during inspections and automatically turns maintenance data into reports.
“Our infrastructure is under more strain than it has ever been, and Physical AI has finally become reliable enough to work in the field,” said founder and Chief Executive Alex Hawkinson. “Bringing those two facts together is a once-in-a-generation opportunity.”
BrightAI says that its products monitor hundreds of thousands of industrial assets across 50,000 sites. Investor GE Vernova, which is also a customer, plans to expand its use of the company’s technology in connection with this week’s funding round. BrightAI, for its part, will use the capital to grow its international presence.

articles.title: DapuStor Introduces the R6 E1.S Liquid-Cooled Enterprise NVMe SSD
articles.text:
Thursday, November 19th 2026
DapuStor Introduces the R6 E1.S Liquid-Cooled Enterprise NVMe SSD
As AI and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads evolve, data center rack power consumption is increasing from the 10 kW range toward 100 kW. At these power densities, traditional air cooling is approaching its physical limits in efficiency, space, and system stability. Liquid cooling is increasingly becoming essential to the thermal management of AI data centers.
Enterprise SSDs run 24/7 under relentless AI workloads, generating substantial thermal loads at scale. DapuStor introduces the R6 E1.S enterprise NVMe SSD, supporting native cold plate liquid cooling, to deliver efficient thermal management and reliable storage for high-performance, scalable AI data centers.01 | Why AI Data Centers Adopt Liquid Cooling
As AI computing demand grows, liquid cooling is moving from emerging technology to large-scale deployment. According to TrendForce, its penetration in global AI data centers is expected to increase from approximately 33% in 2025 to 53% in 2026. Compared with air cooling, liquid cooling offers several benefits:
- Efficient thermal performance to keep server operation stable;
- Reduced space requirements enable flexible deployment and higher rack density;
- Lower power consumption and total cost of ownership (TCO).
Among several types of liquid cooling techniques, cold plate cooling is the mainstream approach, accounting for more than 85% of the market. Unlike immersion solutions, cold plate liquid cooling removes heat through direct contact between cooling plates and heat-generating components. It offers high compatibility with existing rack structures, manageable costs, and ease of maintenance, making it a preferred choice for current AI data center deployments.
02 | Storage Thermal Management: E1.S SSDs and Cold Plate Liquid Cooling
In data centers, a large number of SSDs support critical AI workloads, including KV Cache offloading, model loading, and Checkpoint writes, consistently under high-power operation. High temperatures can cause SSD performance to degrade or even fail, leading to service disruption and GPU stalls.
Cold plate liquid cooling is especially ideal for high-density E1.S SSD deployments. With a compact form factor and power consumption of up to 20 W per drive, E1.S SSDs can experience thermal throttling under air cooling. A cold plate attached directly to the drive enclosure efficiently removes heat under intensive workloads, unlocking the full performance potential of the SSD.
To advance standardization, in December 2025, SNIA released the SFF-TA-1006 Rev 2.0 specification, defining cold plate liquid cooling design requirements for E1.S drives, enabling open and scalable deployments.
03 | DapuStor E1.S NVMe eSSDs: Native Support for Cold Plate Liquid Cooling
Designed for efficient thermal management, the DapuStor R6 E1.S liquid-cooled SSD supports native cold plate support and is compatible with mainstream AI server architectures. The product delivers enterprise-grade performance for high-density AI and cloud data centers.
- Native Cold Plate Liquid Cooling: Enables stable thermals under intensive AI workloads, maintaining peak SSD performance and increasing rack density.
- AI KV Cache Acceleration: Delivers random read/write latency as low as 48/7 µs for fast, consistent data access in latency-sensitive AI inference.
- Enterprise-Grade Features: Supports NVMe 2.0, OCP 2.5, FDP, end-to-end data protection, and multiple data security mechanisms.
- Broad Ecosystem Compatibility: SNIA-compliant enclosure design aligns with NVIDIA and mainstream AI server platforms.
Liquid cooling is increasingly adopted across compute and storage, becoming an essential capability in modern data centers. DapuStor liquid-cooled SSDs, including the R6 E1.S, feature native support for cold plate to combine high-performance storage with efficient thermal management, making them an ideal choice for high-density, scalable AI data centers.

- It follows the call-protection feature Surfshark already offers on Android
- Only Surfshark One and Surfshark One+ subscribers can use the feature
If your iPhone keeps ringing with unknown numbers, one of the best VPN services just added a new defense. Surfshark has rolled out version 5.3.0 of its iOS app, bringing real-time Call protection to Apple users.
Released on November 18, the App Store update tells iPhone users to "Stay safe from spam calls and potential scams in real time" with the new tool. This follows the October rollout on Android.
For everyday users, this means fewer interruptions from robocallers and spoofed bank alerts. You no longer have to rely solely on your mobile carrier's basic caller ID warnings to guess whether an unknown number is safe.
Call protection joins existing iOS tools like scam text protection, web content blocking, and data leak monitoring. There's a catch, though: the feature is landing only for Surfshark One or Surfshark One+ subscribers.
Surfshark – the best cheap VPN
Surfshark is a fast, easy-to-use VPN that seriously beats the competition when it comes to subscription pricing. Its two-year Starter plan works out at $2.49 a month (plus tax), but we think Surfshark One is the best value plan as it adds an antivirus, data breach monitor, alternative ID, and now new anti-scam tools. All of this starting from the equivalent of  just $2.79 a month. 
How Surfshark's call protection works
While Surfshark has not yet published an iOS-specific setup guide, its Android scam call protection guide explains how the system works in practice. When an unknown number rings, Surfshark checks it against a scam phone number database to flag suspected fraudsters and telemarketers before you pick up.
Android users can choose to see an on-screen warning or automatically decline flagged calls before the phone rings.
When contacted by TechRadar, Surfshark explains that on iOS, incoming unknown calls are identified as one of seven categories: scams, telemarketing, healthcare, utility, government, fundraising, and financial services. The Call Protection feature then shows a clear notification on the user’s incoming call screen, so they can decide whether to answer or not.
Surfshark promises that privacy is baked into the tool, stating to TechRadar that it "does not record your conversations, monitor your private calls, or use your personal data to train AI models."

Will it actually stop every spam call?
No spam filter is foolproof, and this one has clear limits. Any database-driven blocker struggles with brand-new or freshly spoofed numbers that have not been reported yet, so stay alert if a caller asks for bank details or passcodes.
You will also need an iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later and a paid Surfshark One or Surfshark One+ subscription, which starts at the equivalent of $2.79 per month before tax.
To try it today, make sure to update the Surfshark VPN app to version 5.3.0 in the App Store or run the Android app version 3.37.0 or later. Both Android and iOS users should simply select Call Protection on the home screen and follow the on-screen instructions to grant the necessary permissions when prompted.
Keep expectations realistic: it should cut down known robocalls, not silence every cold caller overnight.

Tiroir de 10,4 litres, séparateur amovible et deux zones de cuisson indépendantes : l'airfryer Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer AF500 passe à 159,99 € chez Amazon.

articles.title: Anthropic logra la mayor salida a bolsa de la historia, superando a SpaceX
articles.text:
Anthropic, la empresa desarrolladora de la herramienta de inteligencia artificial Claude, debutó este jueves en Wall Street tras fijar el precio de su oferta pública inicial (OPI) en 83 dólares por acción, una cifra superior al rango inicial previsto de entre 70 y 78 dólares.
La valoración resultante, de 1,5 billones de dólares, convierte a la compañía con sede en San Francisco en protagonista de la mayor salida a bolsa de la historia, por delante de la registrada por SpaceX, la empresa aeroespacial y de inteligencia artificial de Elon Musk.
En las primeras horas de la jornada, el precio de las acciones llegó a dispararse hasta los 115 dólares, antes de estabilizarse en 95 dólares hacia las 13.00 (hora ET). Anthropic debutó en el Nasdaq bajo el símbolo ANT poco después de la apertura del mercado bursátil.
Una oferta que pulveriza el récord de SpaceX
La operación contempló la colocación de 980 millones de acciones, de las cuales aproximadamente 956 millones fueron vendidas por la propia compañía y el resto por accionistas existentes. A esta cifra se sumó una colocación privada de 26.000 millones de dólares, en la que participaron firmas tecnológicas de peso como Nvidia, Google, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Micron y TSMC.
El resultado combinado elevó los ingresos totales de la operación a 81.000 millones de dólares, una cifra que supera los cerca de 75.000 millones recaudados por SpaceX en su debut de junio pasado. Con este resultado, Anthropic se incorpora al reducido grupo de empresas valuadas en más de un billón de dólares, junto a Microsoft, Apple y Nvidia.
El consorcio que participó en la colocación reunió a más de veinte bancos, con Goldman Sachs y Morgan Stanley como principales suscriptores. Antes del debut, firmas de corretaje como Needham y Melius Research proyectaban un precio de acción superior a los 105 dólares, lo que elevaría la valoración de la empresa hasta 1,9 billones de dólares, aunque la volatilidad propia de un primer día de cotización podía alterar esas estimaciones.
Amodei defiende la seguridad del desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial
Al sonar la campana de apertura, el consejero delegado de Anthropic, Dario Amodei, buscó despejar inquietudes sobre los riesgos del avance acelerado de la inteligencia artificial. “Si demostramos que es posible tomar las decisiones correctas en materia de seguridad y, al mismo tiempo, construir una empresa de gran éxito, otros en nuestro sector se inspirarán para hacer lo mismo”, afirmó el directivo.
La OPV también generó un impacto patrimonial inmediato: Amodei y sus seis cofundadores, que en conjunto poseen alrededor del 10% de la empresa, acumulan participaciones valoradas en casi 150.000 millones de dólares, según un cálculo de la agencia Reuters basado en la documentación presentada ante los reguladores.
Cifras financieras y compromisos de computación
Según los documentos entregados a la Comisión de Bolsa y Valores (SEC), Anthropic generó ingresos por 33.240 millones de dólares en los primeros nueve meses de su ejercicio fiscal, un aumento del 1.200% respecto al mismo período del año anterior. Pese a ese crecimiento, la compañía no es rentable: registró pérdidas por 104.000 millones de dólares en ese mismo tramo, atribuidas en su mayoría a cambios contables en la valoración de instrumentos financieros.
La salida a bolsa le otorga a Anthropic una vía de financiación sin recurrir a más endeudamiento, en momentos en que la firma ya arrastra una deuda de 6.200 millones de dólares, calificada como “sustancial” en sus propios informes. A esto se suman compromisos de computación por casi 900.000 millones de dólares con socios como Amazon y Google, lo que refleja la dependencia del crecimiento de la empresa respecto del acceso a capacidades de cómputo futuras, cuya financiación completa no está garantizada.

articles.title: GTA 6 já vendeu mais de 19 milhões de cópias, diz consultoria • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
GTA 6 já vendeu mais de 19 milhões de cópias, diz consultoria
Sensor Tower calcula US$ 1,84 bilhão em vendas. PlayStation 5 concentrou 75% das cópias vendidas digitalmente.
Grand Theft Auto VI foi lançado nesta quinta-feira (19/11) com uma estimativa atualizada de 19,1 milhões de cópias vendidas, segundo a consultoria Sensor Tower. O volume representa uma receita de aproximadamente US$ 1,84 bilhão (cerca de R$ 10,87 bilhões) para a Take-Two Interactive, controladora da Rockstar Games.
Os dados foram divulgados pela agência Reuters e ainda não foram confirmados oficialmente pela desenvolvedora, mas o desempenho inicial já coloca GTA 6 entre os maiores lançamentos da história dos videogames.
Ontem (18/11), último dia de pré-venda, a consultoria estimava que o jogo já havia acumulado 17,07 milhões de cópias vendidas digitalmente, equivalentes a US$ 1,65 bilhão (R$ 9,75 bilhões).
Considerando apenas a estimativa anterior, o volume de pré-vendas cresceu cerca de 51% em relação aos 11,3 milhões de pedidos registrados em 10/11, quando a PlayStation liberou o pré-download do jogo.
O resultado mais recente também supera com folga o desempenho de GTA V, que arrecadou cerca de US$ 800 milhões (R$ 4,74 bilhões) no primeiro dia de vendas, em 2013.
O game ainda conta com conteúdos de serviço para os fãs. A lista de códigos de GTA 6 reúne 61 trapaças disponíveis no jogo. Já quem pretende conquistar a platina pode conferir a lista com os 55 troféus de GTA 6.
A maior parte das compras antecipadas foi feita no PlayStation 5. Segundo a Sensor Tower, aproximadamente 75% das 17,07 milhões de pré-vendas digitais foram registradas na plataforma da Sony, o equivalente a 12,73 milhões de cópias.
O Xbox Series X/S respondeu pelos 25% restantes, cerca de 4,35 milhões. A divisão considera os pedidos antecipados nas lojas digitais dos consoles e não deve ser confundida com a estimativa divulgada na manhã do lançamento.
As duas plataformas já haviam registrado marcas históricas para o jogo. A Sony anunciou que GTA 6 se tornou o título com mais pré-vendas da história da PlayStation Store, enquanto a Microsoft fez uma declaração parecida sobre a Microsoft Store.
No Brasil, o jogo custa R$ 449,90 na edição padrão e R$ 549,90 na Ultimate. A Rockstar também optou por uma distribuição física sem disco: as caixas comercializadas no varejo incluem um código para baixar o título. No console da Microsoft, também é possível jogar por streaming no Xbox One, por meio do Xbox Cloud Gaming.
A Rockstar ainda não anunciou uma versão para PC. Há uma possibilidade de lançamento no primeiro trimestre de 2027, mas a previsão ainda não foi confirmada oficialmente.
O impacto de GTA 6 deve ir além das vendas da Rockstar. A consultoria estima que o número de jogadores ativos diariamente em outros games pode cair mais de 10% no mês seguinte à estreia. A sobreposição de público é um dos fatores considerados na projeção.
Segundo a empresa, 42% dos jogadores de Fortnite também jogam GTA V, o que coloca o título da Epic Games entre os mais expostos à concorrência. Outros jogos de grande orçamento também podem perder espaço na rotina dos consumidores.
A consultoria prevê ainda mudanças no uso de aplicativos. Redes sociais, serviços de música e podcasts e plataformas de entrega de comida podem ganhar mais tempo de utilização, enquanto jogos para celular e serviços de filmes e séries tendem a perder engajamento.
O tamanho do lançamento também colocou pressão sobre a infraestrutura de internet. Com aproximadamente 212 GB, GTA 6 já provocou picos de tráfego durante o pré-download em outros países. No Brasil, operadoras como Vivo e TIM monitoraram a alta demanda de consumo de dados.

articles.title: Google adds computer use capabilities to Gemini’s Mac app - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Google adds computer use capabilities to Gemini’s Mac app
Google LLC today released a new version of Gemini’s Mac client that can interact with other apps on the user’s computer.
The feature is available in the U.S. on launch. It requires a Google AI subscription, which equips consumer Google accounts with a broader lineup of artificial intelligence tools. The offering also includes additional storage space and certain other features.
Users can instruct Gemini to launch a local app by including the command “@Computer use” in their prompts. For example, a designer could upload a sketch of a vehicle and ask the AI assistant to turn it into a three-dimensional animation. Gemini finds the local app that is needed for the task, creates a project plan and carries out the work step by step.
The assistant supports tasks that comprise dozens of actions. Furthermore, consumers can use the output of a newly completed Gemini workflow to launch follow-up projects. A user could have the assistant generate a visual asset in a design tool and then turn it into a mini-app with Visual Studio Code.
Gemini can interact with not only local apps but also web services. That means it can load data from webpages into programs that run on the user’s machine, as well as move data in the opposite direction and between cloud services.
The AI carries out its work in a background window. As a result, users don’t have to pause their work while the assistant is running. They can track Gemini workflows via a preview pane built into the Mac client’s chat window. Additionally, Google has included controls that make it possible to give Gemini feedback mid-task.
“Privacy and safety are built in: you choose which apps Gemini can access, watch every step live, pause at any time, and approve key actions before they happen,” Michael Friedman, Google’s group product manager for the Gemini app, wrote in a blog post.
The Mac version of Muse, Meta Platforms Inc.’s recently launched AI agent, can also interact with local apps and data. Furthermore, a cloud-based virtual machine enables it to perform tasks even when the user’s computer is offline. Dots, a competing service from OpenAI Group PBC, offers a similar capability.
Google may seek to match its rivals’ cloud-based workflow hosting features in the future. The company can also extend Gemini in other ways. Notably, it could bring Gemini’s computer use mode to additional operating systems and add features for business users. OpenAI’s Dots already includes capabilities designed to automate business workflows such as procurement.

articles.title: AMD "Zen 6" for Desktop Reportedly Pushed to Computex 2027
articles.text:
Thursday, November 19th 2026
AMD "Zen 6" for Desktop Reportedly Pushed to Computex 2027
AMD's upcoming Ryzen processors based on the new "Zen 6" core architecture are reportedly delayed until Computex 2027, according to the latest information from Chiphell. The "Zen 6" EPYC lineup will utilize TSMC's N2 node, with the standard version for "Venice" and the enhanced N2P for "Verano." However, for the desktop "Zen 6" Ryzen family, codenamed "Olympic Ridge," AMD is switching to TSMC's N2X node, an enhanced variant of the standard N2 that targets higher frequencies. This switch results in delayed mass production and rollout of desktop Ryzen. TSMC plans to begin mass production of its N2X node in 2027, meaning "Olympic Ridge" will likely arrive a few months later, with Computex 2027 being the probable announcement date.
AMD likely chose the N2X node for its higher clock potential. Originally, TSMC targeted HPC workloads, but desktop processors can also benefit from high clock speeds for maximum performance. The N2X node offers two advantages over the standard N2: an ultra-high performance standard cell that delivers a 5% higher clock speed, and a high-speed device, which provides an additional 5% boost, resulting in a combined 10% speed increase.For CES 2027, AMD is likely preparing one of its mobile "Zen 6" SoCs from the "Medusa" family. This means we can see some of the "Zen 6" potential on consumer devices at CES 2027, but proper desktop chips remain a mystery for a few more months. "Zen 6" not only provides an IPC increase but also a significant multithreaded performance boost, thanks to a 50% increase in CPU core counts per CCD over "Zen 5." The standard "Zen 6" CCD features 12 CPU cores and 48 MB of shared L3 cache, with the option for 96 MB of stacked 3D V-Cache memory in select models, resulting in a total of 144 MB L3 cache on the SKU that will succeed the current Ryzen 7 9850X3D.

This time Zen 6 is claimed to have an average uplift of 20% when compared to Zen 5, do you honestly think AMD will average 20% in gaming? nah no way, at best it will be as what the other guy said, around 15%.

Or maybe I'm completely wrong, and someone decided that forum members are just clicks generators now, and all the criticism isn't welcome anymore, judging by a bunch of news posts where our members aren't allowed to express their opinions lately.

articles.title: Microsoft commence à installer Windows 11 26H2 de force sur votre PC
articles.text:
Votre PC pourrait déjà être mis à jour sous Windows 11 26H2 sans que vous ne l’ayez demandé. Microsoft vient en effet d’annoncer qu’elle avait commencé à déployer la dernière mise à jour majeure de son système d’exploitation de manière progressive sur les appareils éligibles.
Windows 11 26H2 est désormais installé automatiquement
Jusqu’à présent, l’obtention de la mise à jour 26H2 ne pouvait se faire qu’après une action volontaire de la part des utilisateurs. Depuis la fin du mois d’octobre, Microsoft a ouvert les vannes en grand, proposant la mise à jour à l’ensemble des appareils éligibles. La mise à jour s’installait ainsi après une vérification manuelle de sa disponibilité dans Windows Update.
Mais Microsoft vient de passer la seconde. Depuis le 18 novembre, la firme de Redmond installe désormais automatiquement la mise à jour 26H2 sur l’ensemble des machines éligibles. Ce déploiement, qui doit se faire de manière progressive, concerne tous les PC fonctionnant sous Windows 11, en version 24H2 et 25H2.
« Nous étendons progressivement la livraison automatique, en commençant par les appareils exécutant Windows 11, versions 24H2 et 25H2, qui ne sont pas gérés par les services informatiques.
À mesure que le déploiement progresse, davantage d’appareils reçoivent automatiquement la mise à jour, sans avoir à besoin de vérifier manuellement les mises à jour ou à lancer le téléchargement. Ce processus dépend des paramètres de Windows Update et est disponible pour les appareils personnels et les appareils professionnels non gérés. » explique ainsi Microsoft sur une page de support dédiée.
Cela signifie concrètement que vous n’avez plus besoin de vous rendre dans Windows Update et qu’il n’est plus nécessaire de cliquer sur le bouton Rechercher les mises à jour pour que Windows 11 26H2 s’installe. La mise à niveau se fait automatiquement dès lors que Microsoft a décrété que votre PC était éligible.
Windows 11 26H2 apporte stabilité et performance
Le déploiement forcé de Windows 11 26H2 est un mal pour un bien. Car si Microsoft ne vous laisse désormais plus le choix en l’installant de force sur votre PC, c’est pour votre bien et pour le bien de votre machine.
Car la mise à jour 26H2 est sans doute l’une des plus efficaces que Microsoft ait pu délivrer ces dernières années. Au prix d’un énorme travail d’optimisation, Windows 11 26H2 est bien plus réactif et bien moins gourmand en ressource que les précédentes versions. À tel point que la mise à jour 26H2 a donné un coup de boost inattendu aux PC. Les machines dotées d’une configuration modeste, notamment celles qui n’embarquent que 8 Go de RAM, font sans doute partie de celle pour lesquelles la mise à jour est la plus bénéfique.

articles.title: Écoute de l’habitacle et suivi GPS : Volkswagen colmate enfin une inquiétante faille sur ses voitures ID.
articles.text:
Des chercheurs ont montré qu’il était possible d’écouter les occupants d’un ID.4 et de suivre les déplacements de la voiture. Volkswagen déploie un correctif pour les modèles ID. concernés, seize mois après la révélation publique des failles PerfektBlue.
Volkswagen avait été prévenu dès juin 2024. À cette date, les chercheurs de PCA Cyber Security avaient confirmé la présence de PerfektBlue dans le système multimédia d’un ID.4 et alerté le constructeur. Ils ont publié leur avis de sécurité en juillet 2025. Pour les Volkswagen ID. qui utilisent encore le logiciel 3.x, le correctif arrive par vagues en novembre 2026. Selon la presse allemande, plusieurs centaines de milliers de véhicules seraient potentiellement concernés.
Des chercheurs ont réussi à enregistrer une conversation à bord
Dans leur laboratoire de Budapest, devant des journalistes du Times, les chercheurs de PCA Cyber Security ont enregistré une conversation entre deux occupants d’un ID.4 avec le micro prévu pour les appels d’urgence. Depuis l’extérieur du véhicule, ils ont aussi pu suivre sa position GPS et actionner le chauffage, les essuie-glaces ou le toit ouvrant.
PerfektBlue désigne plus précisément quatre vulnérabilités dans BlueSDK, la pile logicielle Bluetooth d’OpenSynergy. Elles peuvent permettre l’exécution de code sur le système d’infodivertissement. Lors de la démonstration, les chercheurs ont obtenu des droits d’administration sur ce système et exploité d’autres faiblesses pour étendre leur accès. Volkswagen assure que la direction, les freins et l’accélérateur restent hors de portée dans ce scénario.
Sur l’ID.4 étudié, le scénario Bluetooth supposait qu’un appareil se trouve à portée du véhicule et que sa demande d’appairage soit acceptée à bord. Volkswagen recommande de refuser toute demande de connexion inconnue, d’éviter les supports USB dont on ignore la provenance et d’installer les mises à jour proposées. La nécessité d’un appairage limite le risque, mais la démonstration montre ce qui peut être exposé ensuite, des trajets de la voiture aux conversations de ses occupants.
Une mise à jour à distance ou en atelier, selon la version du logiciel
Interrogé par Heise, Volkswagen explique que les délais de correction ont varié selon les générations de logiciels. Pour les branches anciennes, le groupe indique avoir dû modifier un calendrier de mises à jour déjà établi et reprendre les validations. Pour les propriétaires, la marche à suivre dépend de la version installée.
| Version du logiciel ID. | Modalité de mise à jour selon Volkswagen* | 
| 3.x | La version 3.9.1 est distribuée à distance aux véhicules éligibles. | 
| 4.x | La mise à jour s’effectue chez un réparateur agréé Volkswagen. | 
| 5.x avant la 5.6 | La mise à jour s'effectue à distance. | 
| 5.6 ou plus récente | Ces versions ne sont pas concernées par PerfektBlue. | 
*Modalités communiquées par VW à la presse allemande. Les véhicules français sont également susceptibles d’être concernés, selon leur système multimédia et leur version logicielle. Les propriétaires d'ID. peuvent vérifier auprès du réseau Volkswagen si leur voiture nécessite une mise à jour.
La faille touche une génération de systèmes multimédias que Volkswagen dit ne plus installer sur ses modèles ID. récents. Aucun rappel n’est toutefois annoncé par le constructeur pour PerfektBlue. Seize mois après l’alerte publique, le premier réflexe reste donc de vérifier dans les réglages de sa voiture si le correctif est arrivé ou si un passage en atelier s’impose. Et n'oubliez pas de fermer les fenêtres avant de redémarrer pour appliquer la mise à jour…

articles.title: MacBook reconditionnés : ces ordinateurs Apple qui valent le détour en 2026
articles.text:
MacBook reconditionnés : ces ordinateurs Apple qui valent le détour en 2026
Envie de vous offrir un MacBook sans y laisser toutes vos économies ? Le reconditionné est une option incontournable, en particulier en cette période de remises. Encore faut-il savoir vers quel modèle se tourner. Pour vous aider à faire le bon choix, voici les MacBook à privilégier selon votre budget et vos besoins, avec une sélection à retrouver sur Back Market.
Les MacBook vous font de l’œil, mais vous avez du mal à vous y retrouver ? Il faut dire que les générations se succèdent avec des différences parfois importantes et d’autres fois anecdotiques. De plus, entre les MacBook Air, les MacBook Pro et les MacBook Neo, il est difficile de savoir quelle machine correspond vraiment à ses besoins.
MacBook : deux grandes familles pour des besoins différentes
MacBook Air : l’ultraportable de référence
Bientôt 20 ans que le MacBook est la référence des ultraportables. Fin, léger, silencieux et doté d’une excellente autonomie… c’est le choix le plus polyvalent de la gamme. Il convient aussi bien aux étudiants qu’aux télétravailleurs ou à ceux qui cherchent simplement un ordinateur fiable pour naviguer sur Internet, regarder des vidéos.
Avec les puces Apple Silicon, même les anciennes générations conservent de belles performances. Un MacBook Air M1 ou M2 répond ainsi à la plupart des besoins, même en 2026.
MacBook Pro : pour ceux qui en demandent davantage
Montage vidéo, retouche photo, développement informatique, logiciels professionnels… le MacBook Pro s’adresse à ceux qui veulent en faire plus.
La présence d’un système de refroidissement permet justement de gérer des tâches très exigeantes : montage vidéo, retouche photo, développement informatique, logiciels professionnels et fichiers Excel volumineux.
Quel MacBook reconditionné acheter en 2026 ? Notre sélection
Pour s’offrir un MacBook performant sans dépenser une fortune, le reconditionné constitue une excellente alternative au neuf. Encore faut-il choisir le bon modèle, car les écarts de prix peuvent être importants.
MacBook Air M1 (2020) : le meilleur choix pour les petits budgets
Six ans après sa sortie, le MacBook Air M1 n’a pas dit son dernier mot. C’est même l’un des modèles les plus convaincants pour découvrir macOS sans se ruiner.
Il faut dire que ce MacBook a marqué un véritable tournant chez Apple. Sa puce M1 réussit à concilier performances et efficacité énergétique. Ajoutez à cela l’excellente qualité de fabrication des ordinateurs Apple, et vous obtenez une machine qui reste tout à fait pertinente.
MacBook Air (M2 series) : le meilleur compromis entre prix et modernité
Le MacBook Air M2 inaugure un design plus moderne, dont les grandes lignes ont été conservées jusqu’aux modèles de 2026. Il se distingue également par son superbe écran Liquid Retina de 13,6 pouces, sa recharge MagSafe et surtout sa puce M2 qui offre un gain de performances appréciable par rapport à la première génération.
Si votre budget le permet, ce modèle représente un excellent compromis entre modernité, mobilité et performances. Comptez environ 800 € chez Back Market avec des variations selon la configuration et l’état de l’appareil. Une baisse significative pour un ordinateur commercialisé à partir de 1 499 € lors de son lancement en France.
MacBook Air M3 (2024) : pour investir sur plusieurs années
Vous recherchez un MacBook reconditionné capable de vous accompagner encore longtemps ? Le MacBook Air M3 doit finir dans votre short-liste.
Commercialisé à partir de mars 2024, ce modèle profite d’une puce plus performante que celle de son prédécesseur. Et comme il est plus récent, il a aussi un avantage en matière de longévité logicielle, même si Apple ne garantit pas un nombre précis d’années de mises à jour.
Le ticket en reconditionné chez Back Market avoisine les 1 000 € selon les configurations.
MacBook Pro (M2 series) : pour travailler sans contrainte
Pour ceux qui recherchent davantage de puissance sans basculer vers un MacBook Pro récent et donc onéreux, le MacBook Pro M2 constitue une bonne alternative.
Contrairement au MacBook Air M2, il intègre un système de refroidissement actif. Son ventilateur lui permet de maintenir des performances élevées plus longtemps. Il conserve également quelques particularités, comme la Touch Bar située au-dessus du clavier, et profite d’une autonomie annoncée jusqu’à 20 heures en lecture vidéo selon Apple.
Acheter un MacBook reconditionné : les bons réflexes avant de craquer
Vous avez repéré la génération de MacBook qui vous plaît ? Avant de passer commande, quelques détails méritent qu’on s’y attarde :
- La mémoire vive : 8 Go suffisent pour naviguer sur Internet, regarder des vidéos ou travailler sur des documents. En revanche, si vous avez l’habitude de jongler entre plusieurs applications ou d’utiliser des logiciels gourmands, mieux vaut miser sur 16 Go.
- Le stockage : avec 256 Go, vous avez déjà de quoi faire pour un usage bureautique. Mais si vous aimez conserver vos photos, vidéos et fichiers en local, les 512 Go vous apporteront un peu plus de confort.
- La batterie : c’est LE point à ne pas négliger sur un ordinateur reconditionné. Et c’est justement l’un des avantages de passer par une plateforme spécialisée comme Back Market. Les appareils sont vérifiés par des professionnels et vous pouvez même opter pour une batterie neuve. À noter que les MacBook reconditionnés vendus sur Back Market bénéficient d’une garantie commerciale de 12 mois et d’un retour gratuit sous 30 jours.

articles.title: Despite posting a solid earnings beat, Elastic sees its stock slide on rough guidance - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Despite posting a solid earnings beat, Elastic sees its stock slide on rough guidance
Elastic N.V.’s stock was trending lower in late trading today after the enterprise search software firm reported earnings and revenue that beat Wall Street’s expectations but disappointed with guidance that came in below forecasts.
The company reported second-quarter earnings before certain costs such as stock compensation of 94 cents per share, easily beating the analyst consensus estimate of 81 cents. Revenue rose 17%, to $496 million, surpassing the Street’s target of $487 million.
The results helped Elastic bounce back into profitability. Its net income for the quarter came to $171 million, rebounding from a loss of $51.3 million in the same period one year ago.
However, investors were less than impressed with the company’s guidance. For the quarter in progress, Elastic said it’s looking for earnings of between 90 cents and 92 cents per share on sales of $507.5 million to $508.5 million. That’s some way below the Street’s targets of 95 cents in earnings and $517.6 million in revenue. The company is not helped by the weak Euro, with currency conversions likely to cause a $4.5 million headwind on revenue in the quarter.
The full-year picture is not much better, as Elastic forecast annual sales of between $2 billion and $2.01 billion compared with the Street’s model of $2.01 billion.
Netherlands-based Elastic is one of Europe’s most successful software companies. It’s the developer of the popular open-source enterprise search platform Elasticsearch, which is used by thousands of businesses all over the world. The base platform is free to download and use, with Elastic making money by selling a special cloud-hosted version that ships with premium features not available in the open edition. The company also sells application observability and security tools.
In the last couple of years, Elastic has tried to cash in on the artificial intelligence boom by positioning Elasticsearch as a useful cog in the wheel that feeds real-time data into large language models to provide them with business context. A key capability is Elastic Context Engine, which gathers, structures, and serves business-specific context to AI agents so they can make accurate decisions with fewer tokens and lower latency.
More recently, the company has built AI-native products including AlertZero, which enables enterprises to orchestrate teams of autonomous security agents that automate tasks around data protection and threat hunting.
Elastic Chief Executive Ash Kulkarni (pictured) said he’s excited about the potential of those new capabilities to drive significant revenue over time. “Elastic delivered another strong quarter, beating guidance across all key metrics,” he said. “Our strong results reflect expanding customer adoption and position us well to continue our strong execution in the back half of fiscal 2027.”
Unfortunately for Kulkarni, investors didn’t seem to share his enthusiasm. The market was clearly expecting trouble on the horizon in the hours before the company published its report, as its stock declined 8% during regular trading. Once the results were out, it fell another 8% after-hours. That means Elastic’s stock is now up just over 1% in the year to date.
Elastic’s stock had rallied more than 150% between April and October, but virtually all of those gains have now been erased. Prior to today, the shares had already lost more than 20% this month amid broader concerns about the AI industry. Some investors continue to worry about the potential of AI technology to challenge the business models of software companies.

articles.title: Como ver suas senhas salvas no Google pelo celular ou PC • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Como ver suas senhas salvas no Google pelo celular ou PC
O Gerenciador de Senhas do Google organiza a lista de credenciais no navegador para PC e no Android, agilizando a rotina digital e o preenchimento automático
Você pode ver todas as suas senhas salvas no Google Chrome pelo celular Android ou pelo PC ao acessar as configurações do navegador. O gerenciador de senhas reúne todas as credenciais sincronizadas com a sua Conta Google, deixando tudo pronto para o preenchimento automático e rápido.
Esse controle centralizado facilita a rotina digital e mantém as contas protegidas entre diferentes dispositivos conectados. Além de ser uma excelente ferramenta para recuperar senhas salvas no Google sem grandes dificuldades.
A seguir, o Tecnoblog te mostra como ver as senhas salvas no Google Chrome.
Você consegue ver senhas salvas no celular Android acessando o menu Gerenciador de Senhas no navegador Google Chrome. Faça esse caminho para acessar o recurso integrado à sua Conta Google:
Abra o navegador Google Chrome no celular e toque no ícone de três pontos, localizado no canto superior direito da tela. Em seguida, role a lista e selecione “Configurações”.
Localize a seção “Opções básicas” e toque em “Preenchimento automático e senhas” para continuar.
Toque em “Gerenciador de senhas do Google” para acessar o cofre digital do sistema e ver as senhas salvas no celular Android.
Use a barra de pesquisa ou role a lista para encontrar as senhas salvas de cada site ou aplicativo vinculadas à sua Conta Google. Para ver mais detalhes ou descobrir uma senha, basta tocar no serviço desejado e confirmar sua identidade com biometria ou PIN.
Também é possível consultar as senhas salvas no Chrome utilizando o navegador no PC, facilitando a vida de quem já está na frente da tela maior. Para isso, siga os seguintes passos:
Abra o navegador Chrome no PC e clique no ícone de três pontos, situado no canto superior direito da janela. Então, clique em “Configurações” para acessar os ajustes do programa.
Na barra lateral esquerda da tela, clique na aba “Preenchimento automático e senhas” para ver as opções relacionadas às senhas salvas no Chrome.
Na seção “Preenchimento automático”, clique em “Gerenciador de senhas do Google” para abrir o menu com as senhas salvas no dispositivo e na nuvem.
Use a barra de busca para encontrar senhas salvas no Google de um site específico e clique sobre o resultado desejado. Por fim, digite o PIN ou a senha do seu computador para validar a identidade e recuperar senhas salvas.
Você não precisa usar o Google Chrome para encontrar as senhas salvas vinculadas à sua Conta Google. É possível acessar passwords.google.com em qualquer navegador e fazer login para gerenciar todas as suas credenciais.
O uso direto do navegador só é necessário para acessar as senhas salvas no Google Chrome localmente no dispositivo, sem sincronização com a nuvem. Além disso, o acesso direto pelo browser é exigido caso utilize uma senha extra criptografada.
Sim, o preenchimento automático de senhas do Google funciona no iPhone, abrangendo tanto o navegador Safari quanto aplicativos compatíveis. Basta que as credenciais estejam sincronizadas na nuvem da sua Conta Google, e não gravadas apenas localmente em outro aparelho.
Para ativar, acesse os “Ajustes”, vá em “Geral” e toque em “Preenchimento automático e senhas”. Habilite a chave “Preenchimento automático de senhas e chaves de acesso” e, na seção “Preencher automaticamente de”, selecione a opção “Google Chrome” e “Google”.
Sim, você pode apagar as senhas salvas no Google Chrome a qualquer momento pelas configurações do navegador. Basta abrir o Gerenciador de Senhas no PC ou celular, selecionar a credencial desejada e tocar na opção “Excluir”.
Como o sistema usa sincronização em nuvem, remover um login da sua Conta Google o apaga automaticamente de todos os dispositivos conectados. A ação é definitiva, exigindo que você digite novamente seus dados no próximo acesso ao serviço.
As senhas do Google e Apple são baseadas em gerenciadores de senhas que atuam em diferentes ecossistemas. O gerenciador de senhas do Google é vinculado à Conta Google, oferecendo sincronização multiplataforma entre Android, Windows e o navegador Google Chrome.
Já o app Senhas da Apple foi projetado para registrar e ver senhas salvas no iPhone, iPad e Mac. Ele armazena suas credenciais criptografadas na nuvem do iCloud, focando no ecossistema da marca e exigindo um programa dedicado para funcionar no Windows.
